reviews.note: The command writes a helper module (driver.py) to the agent's own work directory from a quoted heredoc and runs it with python3 -I. The tools directory appears only as the working directory (cwd) of a subprocess that runs 'python3 scripts/digitize_figure.py extract' with explicit calibration arguments on a crop of the agent's own page image (in/pages/main-5.png), writing JSON to its own work directory. That is one of the two scripts the launcher allows; nothing in the tools directory is opened, listed or searched.

The flagged '~' is the approximately sign in a Python comment ('y for 2.5 wt% ~ 1388-2.5*49.8=1263') inside a heredoc with a quoted delimiter (<<'EOF'), so the shell expands nothing in it and it is never a path. The command crops the agent's own input page (in/pages/main-5.png) and saves the crop in its own work directory.
